svg.title: Private document review | Current Azure service architecture
svg.desc: Two workflow lanes: private portal upload, Content Understanding extraction and owner self-review; publication of approved PDFs and corrected fields, Search and Foundry IQ retrieval, and direct no-tools Azure OpenAI inference. The API enforces case-and-owner authorization and validates sources and citation IDs. API and worker share one trusted identity. Model suggestions cannot authorize publication and require human verification. Synthetic-only; not a live readiness report.

text.tspan: Synthetic documents only. People make decisions; model answers are suggestions.
2 Publish evidence and ask case-scoped questions
Citation IDs do not prove truth
API and worker share one trusted identity; containers are not privilege isolation.
Model output cannot authorize publication. Instructions do not guarantee grounded answers.
All app/data access is private. Network access is shown separately in the connectivity diagram.
Arrows summarize the workflow, not every network request. Infrastructure publication is not proof of live readiness.
